title: docs/configuration.md: three rows contradict the code (legionella interval 7 vs 10 days; 60 s echo grace not applied)
claim: docs/configuration.md holds 3 ledger rows whose executed check contradicts production: two settings-table rows give the anti-legionella interval default as 7 days while every _OPTION_FIELDS row and ThermalParameters default to 10, and line 894's sentence says readings in the first 60 s after a write are not counted while pump_arbiter.hold counts a differing reading at +5 s (and ECHO_GRACE_S is 20 s).
mechanism: The table cell and the prose were written against a default and a grace the code does not carry: DEFAULT_DHW_LEGIONELLA_INTERVAL_DAYS is 10.0 (config_flow _OPTION_FIELDS hot_water row, thermal_model.ThermalParameters), and hold() drops the write record (counts a miss) on the first differing reading with no time gate, so no window of 60 s (or 20 s) is honoured.

proposed_fix_scope: Decide the intended values (owner): either the legionella default returns to 7 days or both configuration.md rows say 10; and either hold() honours an echo window after a write (pump_arbiter) or line 894's sentence states the real window; then align the sentence to the measured value.
